{{Quote|They found the Palace. The Royal Palace. It's in the Graveyard. Go to Mining Outpost 11. The report was filed there. One scout also said they found... Bail Organa... hurry...|[[Zaz Kamiroz]], to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="GoA" />}}
'''Operation Yavin Kill Two''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operation designed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to capture the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] in the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[The Graveyard|Graveyard]]. The Empire spread misinformation that the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] was found intact in the debris field, and that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] was found alive inside. A group of Rebel operatives explored the ruins of the palace before the arrival of the Heroes of Yavin and foiled the Imperial trap. Moreover, the Rebels discovered the [[Alderaanian War Frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'', an [[armory ship]] carrying all the armaments of Alderaan.<ref name="GoA" />
